passages.title: Lunar low-pressure centrifugal test protocol
passages.text: The study targeted 56.5 kPa (8.2 psia). Glenn tests used a 20.4 RPM centrifuge during 5.2-second drops, producing nominal one-sixth-g radial acceleration. Oxygen limits varied by material; results depend on ignition and short-duration extinction protocols.
